title: RANKING THE CREEPIEST
THINGS YOUR BODY DOES AT NIGHT

lines.text: Ranking the creepiest things your body does while you sleep.
Number five: you grow. Your spine stretches out overnight, and you wake up a centimeter taller.
Number four: your nose shuts off. Smoke almost never wakes a sleeping person.
Number three: your brain washes itself, flushing out the day's waste.
Number two: that falling jolt? It's your muscles twitching as you drift off.
And number one: every night, your body paralyzes you, so you can't act out your dreams.
